Taxpayers must have federal adjusted gross income not exceeding "twenty-five thousand dollars or less for a married couple or a single person who is a head of a household" or "twelve thousand five hundred dollars or less for a single person or a married person filing separately." The credit applies to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2000. Certain individuals may claim this benefit without filing a full tax return if they meet specified conditions. Individuals sentenced to custody for at least sixty days during the taxable year are ineligible, effective for years beginning after December 31, 2002.
